2026 opens a new chapter in the Dalton Medical legacy: a privately owned manufacturer with a ten-year plan, focused on doing a few categories exceptionally well rather than listing everything. For a dealer that shows up as a shorter supply chain, fewer hands between the factory and your dock, and a partner who can adapt a product to what you actually sell.

Next Generation HomeCare Bed

iSeries 3 in 1 Bed

The iSeries is Dalton's new-generation homecare bed, designed so that one frame covers what used to take three. Conversion from semi-electric to full-electric to high/low is tool free, which cuts the number of beds a dealer stages and the number of parts kept on the shelf. A slat deck adds rigidity across the sleeping surface, and redesigned head and foot connections are built to survive repeated transport. Quick-connect deck joiners let the two halves be joined flat on the floor — no angling the deck on its side — so setup and teardown stay a one-person job.

Why dealers are opening Dalton

Three reasons this line earns its shelf space

Straight from Dalton's own introduction — and the reasons HomeCare Provider Services took the line on.

1. You buy from the factory

Dalton ownership owns the factories. As both manufacturer and distributor they adapt quickly to what you need and take the middleman out — which is where the time and the money go.

2. Depth instead of breadth

Four manufactured categories rather than a catalogue of everything, which is what makes container programs, custom products and custom branding possible on the lines you actually stock.

3. Quality you can stand behind

Every device passes rigorous internal safety inspection and third-party compliance testing before it reaches your floor, backed by leadership with decades in this business.
